title: VPN & Proxy Policy Template - Employee Privacy Guidelines
metaDescription: Professional VPN and proxy policy template for organizations. Define clear guidelines for secure remote access and employee privacy protection.
description: Comprehensive policy template for organizations implementing VPN and proxy services. Covers security protocols, acceptable use guidelines, and privacy protection measures for employees working remotely or accessing sensitive data.

sections.heading: Policy Overview and Purpose
sections.content: This VPN and Proxy Policy establishes guidelines for the secure use of Virtual Private Network (VPN) and proxy services within {{organization_name}}. This policy ensures that all remote connections maintain the highest security standards while protecting sensitive company data and employee privacy. All employees, contractors, and third-party users must comply with these guidelines when accessing company resources remotely.

sections.heading: Approved VPN Services and Requirements
sections.content: {{organization_name}} mandates the use of approved VPN services for all remote access to company networks and systems. Approved VPN solutions must meet the following criteria: AES-256 encryption, no-logs policy verification, kill switch functionality, and multi-factor authentication support. Employees are prohibited from using free VPN services due to security risks including data logging, malware distribution, and inadequate encryption. For additional privacy protection during web browsing, employees may use Incognito Browser alongside approved VPN services.

sections.heading: Proxy Service Guidelines
sections.content: When proxy services are required for specific business functions, employees must use only company-approved proxy servers. Personal or third-party proxy services are strictly prohibited for accessing company resources. Approved proxy services must provide: secure HTTPS connections, authentication mechanisms, activity logging for security monitoring, and compatibility with company firewall systems. IT department maintains a list of approved proxy services updated quarterly.

sections.heading: Public Wi-Fi and Remote Work Security
sections.content: When working from public locations or using public Wi-Fi networks, employees must always connect through an approved VPN service before accessing any company resources. This includes coffee shops, airports, hotels, and co-working spaces. Direct connections to company systems via public networks are strictly forbidden. Employees should verify VPN connection status before transmitting any sensitive information and use additional privacy tools like Incognito Browser to prevent local data storage on shared devices.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use and Prohibited Activities
sections.content: VPN and proxy services provided by {{organization_name}} are intended solely for legitimate business purposes. Prohibited activities include: accessing illegal content, circumventing company security policies, downloading unauthorized software, conducting personal business during work hours, and sharing VPN credentials with unauthorized individuals. Employees must not use company VPN services for personal activities that could compromise network security or violate local laws.

sections.heading: Technical Requirements and Configuration
sections.content: All VPN clients must be configured according to IT department specifications and maintained with current security updates. Required settings include: automatic connection on untrusted networks, DNS leak protection enabled, IPv6 leak protection activated, and automatic kill switch functionality. Employees must not modify VPN configurations without explicit IT approval. Regular connectivity tests and security audits will be conducted to ensure compliance with these technical requirements.

sections.heading: Monitoring and Compliance
sections.content: {{organization_name}} reserves the right to monitor VPN and proxy usage for security and compliance purposes. This monitoring includes connection logs, bandwidth usage, accessed resources, and security incident detection. While respecting employee privacy, the organization will investigate any suspicious activity or policy violations. Employees who violate this policy may face disciplinary action up to and including termination. Regular training sessions will be provided to ensure ongoing compliance and security awareness.

sections.heading: Incident Reporting and Support
sections.content: Employees must immediately report any VPN or proxy-related security incidents to the IT security team at {{security_contact}}. This includes suspected data breaches, unauthorized access attempts, malware infections, or connection compromises. The IT department provides 24/7 support for VPN-related issues and maintains documentation for troubleshooting common problems. Emergency contact procedures are available for critical security incidents requiring immediate response.

useCases: Corporate IT departments implementing remote work policies
Small businesses establishing VPN usage guidelines
Organizations with remote workforce security requirements
Companies handling sensitive customer data remotely
Educational institutions providing secure network access
Consulting firms working with multiple client networks
